reference_sql:
SELECT promo_type, COUNT(*) AS n_promotions
FROM promotions
GROUP BY promo_type
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 9
alternatives: SELECT promo_type, COUNT(promo_id) AS n_promotions FROM promotions GROUP BY promo_type HAVING COUNT(promo_id) >= 9
SELECT promo_type, COUNT(*) AS n_promotions FROM promotions GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 8
